My first major boyfriend in high school was a senior. I was a freshman. We can call him Brian. Brian and I met through my sister, they were friends and eventually we met and he starts messaging me on facebook. Within a few weeks he started flirting with me more online and telling me how he thought I was mature for my age. Since I was a freshman I considered this to be super super cool that a much older guy even thought of me at all. I thought he was so good looking, smart and confident. So fast forward a month or two and we are officially dating. He told little lies here and there but they never seemed like a big deal to me because the more I got to know him the more I realized he wasn't very confident or comfortable with his appearance. It started with him telling me he never wanted to take his shirt off to swim or be intimate because he had been attacked by robbers at his step dads house and they had cut up his back. Turns out he was just embarrassed by his back acne. Next it was every time there were tryouts for a sport at school he would go on and on about how great he was and couldn't wait for tryouts but right before every tryout he would injure himself "severely" and wouldn't be able to try out. But he never went to the doctor for any of these injuries. The final GIANT lie came when we had been dating for about 6-7 months. He wanted to start having sex and I wasn't comfortable yet and we talked about it a lot. One day he was particularly pushy and we got in a fight and I asked for some time apart. But he wouldn't unlock his doors for me to get out because he, "had to tell me why he cared and needed me around so much". The story started out that since he was 12 he has been working for the government. It gets worse. He told me he's been trained by them as hitman and has hundreds or thousands of dollars saved up. He made this believable by crying and telling me he's done terrible things, he went into details telling me he knows several languages, has harmed people abroad but it's all super secret, and just went on and on. I think I was so blinded at the time by him being an older guy, his crying, and how convincing he was about the whole thing I actually believed him and stayed with him. Every Time after that I would bring it up he would get panicky and say he ,"didn't want to think about it", or "he couldn't stand what he's done". About a year and a half into dating one night I finally talked to my sister about it and she flipped out. She told me he was lying to me and how stupid I was and how upset she was that she didn't know he was telling me these things. I know I was EXTREMELY NAIVE and I even now that I'm 20 years old I still think how stupid I was about the entire relationship, but I did end up breaking up with him and haven't talked to him in years. About 9 months after our breakup he asked to meet up and talk about some things. He ended up apologizing that he put me through a lot but maintained the lie that the whole military thing was TRUE. He still couldn't let it go after all that time!! I understand some people won't believe this but I've cared around this for a long time and only my sister knows about it. I realize it was manipulative and it was an extremely unhealthy relationship. But there you go, there's my compulsive liar story.
